feature_name: Radar Chart Support with Multi-Series Enhancement
description: Add radar chart functionality to the charting system and extend support for multiple data series across existing chart types. This will enable users to create radar charts for visualizing multivariate data and allow all chart types to display multiple data series with distinct visual styling.
functional_requirements: Implement a new radar chart type that displays data points on axes radiating from a center point
Extend existing chart types (bar, line) to support multiple data series with distinct colors and styling
Update the chart parsing and rendering logic to handle the new radar chart format and multi-series data structures
Add radar chart and multi-series options to the chart creation UI and paste dialog interface
Ensure proper serialization/deserialization of radar charts and multi-series data for clipboard operations and file persistence
Update test suites to cover the new radar chart functionality and multi-series behavior across all chart types
